complexity.rationale: Single Rust crate, no code yet. Hard parts are byte-exact emulation of Composer's autoloader output and safe filesystem work (zip extraction, hardlinks into a shared cache, replacing vendor dirs); both are pinned by golden tests copied from Composer.

plan.rationale: Greenfield: cache layout, atomicity and compatibility decisions are cheap to plan and expensive to redo. Opus suffices; no distributed-systems complexity to justify fable.

code.rationale: Byte-diff goldens and Composer's own fixture tables catch emulation mistakes, so mid-tier is safe for TDD steps against an approved plan.

review.rationale: Small per-step diffs with clippy -D warnings and nextest in the gate; filesystem-mutating paths escalate below.

escalations.action: review uses opus (extracts untrusted zips into a shared cache; path sanitising and atomic rename)
review uses opus (deletes and replaces vendor package dirs; hardlinks share inodes with the cache)
review uses opus (decides which vendor dirs are removed)
raise code one tier for this task
